dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日本医師会標準レセプトソフト), screen S09 - insurance information update screen

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (insurance billing) system - insurance information update screen (保険情報変更画面)
purpose.summary: ORCGS09 is a screen program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system handling insurance information updates. It manages a GUI screen (S09) for editing insured person numbers, insurance type (company/national), principal/family classification, insurance symbols and numbers. It performs input validation, database lookups for insured person information, and screen navigation.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (29 copybooks) for screen areas and data structures
MCP (Message Control Program) event-driven GUI framework typical of JMA ORCA
Japanese text in comments and data literals (EUC-JP encoded)
Combo-box list management for insurance type classification
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP database access layer
PERFORM-heavy structured programming with SECTION-based paragraphs
EXIT PROGRAM at end of main section
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (decoded as latin-1), causing garbled display of Japanese characters in comments and string literals. This is definitively part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The file is truncated at 16000 chars but the structure is clear. Program uses GnuCOBOL (formerly OpenCOBOL) with the ORCA MCP framework rather than CICS, though the program_type is functionally equivalent to an online transaction program.
